scope: Ten native Aug22 wrist-stream descriptive replays; separate qualification for future opt-in guard. No simulator/model/hardware, source writes, or primary-study score changes.

rules.initialization: exact first native arm_ft row in each stream
rules.time: native stored master-clock timestamps; not resampled
rules.baseline_update: rolling only while deviation is below both limits; episode_fixed never updates

rolling.continuation_semantics: Entire observed stream is inspected descriptively after hypothetical first stop; no alternate closed-loop trajectory is inferred.

episode_fixed.continuation_semantics: Entire observed stream is inspected descriptively after hypothetical first stop; no alternate closed-loop trajectory is inferred.

initial_0_to_1s_evidence.time_reference: first native arm_ft row; no preselected simulator anchor or timestamp-offset reapplication

unloaded_adjudication.assessment: initial distal-unloaded interval supported by combined sampled RGB, continuous tactile-area and high-TCP evidence; not certification of all robot external contacts
unloaded_adjudication.temporal_limit: Three RGB samples near0/.5/1s, exact timestamps and hashes listed; RGB alone does not establish continuous depth clearance or exclude occluded proximal contacts.

limits: Recorded later contacts are not adjudicated, so trigger counts are not false-positive rates.
No current-based UR3 wrench calibration or real-hardware safety qualification is inferred.
Three RGB samples support only sampled visual evidence; tactile area/wrench and arm motion characterize the full initial second.
Continuing the fixed recorded stream after a hypothetical stop is descriptive, not a predicted altered demonstration.
manual_review_semantics: Numerical extractor initially marks unloaded adjudication pending; these review annotations were added after inspecting all30 hashed RGB previews. Re-running --with-preview regenerates the reviewed images.
